earlier_scan.note: Glottolog: phantom language, retired from ISO 639-3 (2013); no language of this name exists, so no stress source

sources.citation: ISO 639-3 Registration Authority (2012). Change Request Number 2012-082: retire [myq] 'Maninka, Forest' (submitted by Valentin Vydrin, LLACAN; adopted, effective 2013-01-23). SIL International.
sources.note: Nothing; it is a code-retirement form. Section 3(c), p.2: 'Forest Maninka is a phantom language. I'm afraid, I'm partly guilty of its emergence: many years ago, I invented this term as generic for the continuum Manya - Konya - Odienne Jula, and later on, someone reinterpreted it as a language of a lower level. In reality, no language of this name exists.'

sources.citation: Hammarström, Forkel, Haspelmath & Bank, Glottolog 5.x, languoid page fore1268 'Bookkeeping: Forest Maninka'.
sources.note: Nothing; page states the entry is retired for bookkeeping only (ISO retirement 2012-082, reason: non-existent, effective 2013-01-23) and lists zero descriptive references.
